title: RBI Defers Revised Basel III Pillar 3 Disclosure Norms Implementation to April 1, 2027
summary: Pushes back commencement to align Pillar 3 market discipline disclosures with Expected Credit Loss (ECL) provisioning.

blocks.content: Pushes back commencement to align Pillar 3 market discipline disclosures with Expected Credit Loss (ECL) provisioning.

items: Revised Timeline: Deferred from September 30, 2026 to April 1, 2027 (1st revised quarterly disclosure for quarter ending June 30, 2027).
Regulatory Directions: RBI issued 10 amendment directions covering commercial banks, SFBs, and payments banks.
Pillar 3 Scope: Mandates consolidated public disclosures on capital adequacy, risk-weighted assets (RWAs), and risk governance.

blocks.summary: Basel III standards developed by Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS), Basel, Switzerland.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: Pillar 3 deferred implementation date (April 1, 2027) vs 1st revised quarterly report (June 30, 2027).

blocks.quote:
Interview Focus Question: "Why did RBI defer Basel III Pillar 3 disclosure norms to April 2027?"
💡 **Model Answer: Grants banks IT upgrade preparation time to align Pillar 3 market disclosures with Expected Credit Loss (ECL) credit-risk capital norms.**
